overall_summary: The channel is experiencing a clear surge in performance when focusing on extreme space anomalies and bizarre exoplanet conditions (e.g., TrES-2b, Gliese 436b, and diamond planets), which generate the highest views (up to 1,055) and engagement. Conversely, generic psychology trivia and repetitive brain facts are severely underperforming, rarely breaking 100 views.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Exoplanet Anomalies & Bizarre Space Physics
winning_patterns.evidence: TrES-2b (1,019 views), Gliese 436b (1,055 views), and the $26 Nonillion Diamond Planet (452 views) represent the channel's top-performing tier, driving the highest likes and comments.
winning_patterns.action: Focus content production on extreme planetary conditions, cosmic anomalies, and space 'What If' scenarios with high-value or high-danger hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple uploads of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' yielded extremely low views (5 to 53 views), and 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' got only 38 views.
weak_patterns.action: Phase out basic psychological trivia and avoid re-uploading identical hooks without significant visual or structural changes.
